field_descriptions.area_served: The geographic area where a service or offered item is provided.
field_descriptions.available_language: A language someone may use with or at the item, service or place. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[inLanguage]].
field_descriptions.contact_option: An option available on this contact point (e.g. a toll-free number or support for hearing-impaired callers).
field_descriptions.contact_type: A person or organization can have different contact points, for different purposes. For example, a sales contact point, a PR contact point and so on. This property is used to specify the kind of contact point.
field_descriptions.hours_available: The hours during which this service or contact is available.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.product_supported: The product or service this support contact point is related to (such as product support for a particular product line). This can be a specific product or product line (e.g. "iPhone") or a general category of products or services (e.g. "smartphones").
field_descriptions.service_area: The geographic area where the service is provided.
